What Is The LOOKS Airdrop?
On this page
What Is The LOOKS Airdrop?
As part of LooksRare’s initial launch, we’re distributing 120,000,000 LOOKS tokens (12% of total supply) to the NFT community.
If you’ve traded NFTs on Opensea in the period detailed below, you might be able to claim LOOKS on
https://looksrare.org
– keep reading to learn how!
🚨Caution! The LOOKS Airdrop is only available on
LooksRare.org
, and only live for a few days - avoid any other links. Don’t get scammed.🚨
💸 Who Can Claim the Airdrop, and How Much?
​
In short, anyone with a combined 3 ETH trading volume or more on Opensea over a six month period (from Ethereum Block 12642194 on 16th Jun 2021 to Block 13812868 on 16th Dec 2021) is eligible to claim LOOKS, once they list an ERC-721 or ERC-1155 NFT for sale on LooksRare.
Before you list an item, however, make sure you are eligible by going to
https://looksrare.org
, connecting your wallet, and clicking "check now" in the big green banner at the top of the page.
If it says "No tokens to claim", you don't meet the eligibility criteria. Make sure your OpenSea volume is within the specified time period.
Airdrop Duration
​
You’ll only be able to claim LOOKS from the airdrop during a short window of 7-10 days (exact time TBD).
Any LOOKS that isn’t claimed by the end of the airdrop period will go to the treasury for use in ecosystem development.
Conditions to Claim
​
To claim the designated airdrop, an eligible user must first successfully list any ERC-721 or ERC-1155 NFT on the LooksRare exchange.
Eligible Period
​
LooksRare recorded all trading volume conducted by all users of Opensea from Ethereum Block 12642194 to Block 13812868 (16th Jun 2021 to 16th Dec 2021). Only volume on the Ethereum blockchain was recorded: Polygon blockchain (MATIC) volume is not included.
Tiers
​
We've set 9 different tiers for the airdrop. Each eligible wallet will be able to claim an amount of LOOKS corresponding to their total trading volume in ETH.
The volume calculation for each user includes both buy and sell trades made in
ETH, WETH, USDC, DAI, SAND, GALA
and
MANA
over that 6-month period. The final volume calculation has been denominated in ETH: any volume from sales settled in other tokens has been converted to ETH based on the ETH/

How to Claim Your LOOKS
​
Head to
https://looksrare.org
during the airdrop period detailed above.
Connect your wallet to the site.
Click the button in the banner at the top of the page, to check whether you’re eligible for the airdrop.
If you’re eligible, you’ll see a message inviting you to list an NFT.
Head to your account, view your items, and
list one or more of your NFTs
for sale.
Once you successfully list your item, you can claim your LOOKS via the banner on the homepage!
If you’re not eligible, but you think you should be, make sure you’ve connected to the right wallet, and check again to make sure you’ve met all the above criteria precisely. Sorry - we can’t add or remove anyone at this point.
LOOKS Token Contract
​
The only genuine LOOKS Token contract address is:
0xf4d2888d29d722226fafa5d9b24f9164c092421e
LOOKS is an ERC-20 token, currently only on the Ethereum blockchain.
I Claimed LOOKS. Now What?
​
Sure, you COULD go ahead and sell your airdrop. But…
💯 100% of LooksRare’s trading fees are distributed among LOOKS token stakers.
🤑 LOOKS stakers also earn more LOOKS.
So.
If you like the sound of earning WETH and LOOKS…
Stake your LOOKS Tokens to Earn!
